name: pumi-agents
description: Tells an agent about the workspace it is in: a short guide to pumi, and a map of the sessions, tabs and panes around it — once, then only what changed. The sidebar is the app theme's.

context.label: Agent context
context.desc: Tell agents about your workspace. Off silences it for every agent.

updates.label: Updates
updates.desc: Keep agents up to date as panes open, close and move, or tell them only when they start.

other_sessions.label: Other sessions
other_sessions.desc: Include panes from your other sessions, not only the current one.

targets.label: Agents turned off
targets.desc: Which agents are not told, by id: `{"codex": false}`. Every other agent is told while its hook is installed.
